scenes.vo: 4 November ka dividend chakkar kya hai? Saath mein 9 aur khabrein.
Ek: Coal India, Asian Paints dividend de rahe hain, taareekh 4 November.
Do: EAAA India share bazaar mein aayi, bade funds ne kaafi hissa khareeda.
Teen: Sri Lotus ke malik apne shares bechenge, Sebi ke niyam ki wajah se.
Chaar: Sebi ka naya niyam, videshi paisa ab kiraye wali property funds mein aayega.

card.line: America ka bhari dividend, jokhim bhi

scenes.vo: Paanch: America ki kuch companies bhari dividend deti hain, jokhim bhi bada hai.
Chhe: Reliance ki tezi aur tax raahat ke prastav se bazaar uchhla.
Saat: Gold-silver October mein kaafi gire, Dhanteras ki planning sasti ho sakti hai.

card.line: England mein byaaj badh sakta hai

scenes.vo: Aath: Goldman Sachs ke hisaab se England mein byaaj phir badh sakta hai.
Nau: AI ke kharche se bade tech ne share buyback 83 percent ghataye.
Das: Gold record se 30 percent se zyada gira, analyst kam umeed bata rahe.
